styles.normal: Boss shortest route plus 50% independently selected optional targets, including every prerequisite room; balanced fixed perk weights.
styles.optimized: All generated rooms and all drops; stronger damage weighting for portal perk choices.
styles.conservative: Boss shortest route plus 20% optional targets and prerequisites; stronger health-perk weighting, healing threshold 75% rather than 50%.

shared_policy: Pick up each generated potion once through WorldItem; preserve four-unit capacity and unaccepted ground units. Equip stronger sampled equipment, discard replaced gear. No stat assignment to reach targets.
clock: Controlled accepted Orc hit per visited combat room, then 20 simulated seconds using production cooldown/regen callbacks. Potion consumption uses its real eight-second cooldown.
measurement: Entry before that floor rewards; exit after boss/chest rewards but before current portal perk and descent vitality.
counterfactual: Before holds all other fixes/policies constant and overrides only boss vitality credit in the test room, matching the old absence of floor HP. Original actual three-seed data remains in issue75_progression_samples.json.
limits: Successful room and boss clears assumed for reward sampling, not automated AI combat.
Reward-only ordinary enemies use BaseEnemy with authoritative enemy IDs and actual death/drop code.
Boss loot uses its initial source RNG, without phase-dependent RNG consumption.
Combat measurements are isolated open-arena callbacks; no spirit, combo finisher or skills included in basic-hit counts.
No autonomous or interactive playthrough; rest and accepted-hit clock are explicit scenarios.
